what: Each heading line is covered by two bars (a lower background-color bar and an upper accent lead bar). When the top reaches 90% of the screen, the heading rises from 14px below in .55s, .3s later the lead bar shrinks to the right edge over .6s power3.inOut, and the background bar shrinks the same way .14s later — each line .1s later, with a brief accent tail left at the end of the text. Plays once

options.dir: Side the bar shrinks toward: right (default)·left·up·down
options.order: If end, from the next line down
options.wait: Time before the bar moves after it rises (sec), default .3
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.65,0,0.35,1”, default power3.inOut
options.--fx-bar: Base bar color (CSS variable), default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-lead: Front panel bar color (CSS variable), default var(--kf-accent)

use: Your title here Blurred Tail Text
